# BQA Homes and Villas

> BQA Homes and Villas is an independent collection of holiday homes in Italy: two properties in Rome (Trastevere and Flaminio) and a countryside trullo with a private pool in Puglia (Castellana Grotte, Valle d'Itria). Guests can book directly with the host by WhatsApp or email. The website is available in Italian and English.

## Properties

- [BQA San Crisogono Apartments Rome-Trastevere](https://bqahomesandvillas.com/en/trastevere.html): historic 80 sqm apartment in Trastevere, Rome, on a quiet street. Separate bedroom and living room, best for 2-3 guests (up to 4), fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, wi-fi, self check-in. Second floor, no elevator. Italian version: https://bqahomesandvillas.com/trastevere.html
- [BQA Fracassini Rooms Rome-Flaminio](https://bqahomesandvillas.com/en/flaminio.html): rooms in the Flaminio district of Rome, near Piazza del Popolo, the Stadio Olimpico and the Auditorium Parco della Musica. Three room types with private bathroom, air conditioning, wi-fi, fully equipped kitchen; building with elevator. Italian version: https://bqahomesandvillas.com/flaminio.html
- [BQA La Masseriola Private Pool Villa-Trullo](https://bqahomesandvillas.com/en/masseriola.html): trullo and countryside villa with a private pool in Castellana Grotte, Puglia, in the Valle d'Itria among olive trees. Up to 4 guests (+1 on request), 2 bedrooms, garden and barbecue area, free private parking; a car is recommended. Italian version: https://bqahomesandvillas.com/masseriola.html

## Key facts

- Independent host (Guido), not affiliated with Marriott Bonvoy "Homes & Villas by Marriott International" or any hotel chain.
- Direct booking: contact the host by WhatsApp or email; the properties are also listed on Airbnb and Booking.com.
- Self check-in at all properties; the host is reachable remotely.
- Languages: Italian and English.
